title: Return policy
text:
You can return most items within 10 days of delivery. Items must be unused, with the original tags and packaging.

Groceries, beauty products that have been opened, and innerwear cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. Electronics can be returned only if they are faulty or damaged on arrival.

title: How to start a return
text:
Open My Orders in the app, choose the item and tap Return. Pick a reason and a pickup slot.

Our courier collects the item from your address. Keep the item packed and ready, with the return label printed or written on the package. You will get an SMS when the pickup is done.

title: Refund timelines
text:
Refunds start after the returned item passes a quality check at our warehouse, usually within 2 days of pickup.

Money goes back to the original payment method. UPI and wallet refunds arrive within 24 hours. Card refunds take 5 to 7 business days. Cash on delivery orders are refunded to your ShopKart wallet or a bank account you add.

title: Delivery times
text:
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 days in metro cities and 5 to 8 days elsewhere. Express delivery, available in 40 cities, delivers the next day if you order before 2 pm.

Delivery dates are shown on the product page after you enter your pincode.

title: Delivery charges
text:
Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499. Orders below that have a Rs 40 delivery fee. Express delivery costs Rs 99 extra, and is free for ShopKart Plus members.

Bulky items such as furniture may have an extra handling charge, shown at checkout.

title: Tracking an order
text:
Go to My Orders and tap the order to see live tracking. You will also get SMS and email updates when the order is packed, shipped and out for delivery.

If tracking has not changed for 3 days, contact support and we will raise a query with the courier.

title: Cancelling an order
text:
You can cancel an order for free until it is shipped. Open My Orders, tap the order and choose Cancel.

After the order has shipped you cannot cancel it, but you can refuse the delivery or return it after it arrives. Prepaid cancellations are refunded within 24 hours to UPI and wallets.

title: Payment methods
text:
We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ShopKart wallet and cash on delivery.

Cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs 10,000 and is not available for gift cards. EMI is available on credit cards for orders above Rs 3,000.

title: Failed payment but money deducted
text:
If your payment failed but money was deducted, do not pay again right away. The bank usually reverses the amount automatically within 5 to 7 business days.

If the order was actually placed, you will see it in My Orders within 30 minutes. If not, the amount is returned to your account by your bank.

title: ShopKart Plus membership
text:
ShopKart Plus costs Rs 999 a year. Members get free express delivery, early access to sales and 5 percent extra cashback on the ShopKart credit card.

You can cancel Plus within 14 days for a full refund if you have not used any benefit.

title: Warranty and repairs
text:
Most electronics come with a manufacturer warranty of 1 year. The warranty card or invoice in your order is your proof of purchase.

For repairs, contact the brand's service centre listed on the warranty card. ShopKart does not repair products, but we can help you find the nearest service centre.

title: Damaged or wrong item received
text:
If you receive a damaged, defective or wrong item, report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders. Upload clear photos of the item and the package.

We will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. You do not need to pay any return fee for these cases.

title: Changing the delivery address
text:
You can change the delivery address only before the order is shipped. Open the order and tap Change Address.

After shipping, the address cannot be changed. You can ask the courier to hold the parcel at the nearest pickup point instead.

title: Account and password
text:
To reset your password, tap Forgot Password on the login screen and enter your registered mobile number. We send a one-time password by SMS.

ShopKart staff will never ask for your password or OTP. Do not share them with anyone, even if they say they are from ShopKart.

title: Deleting your account
text:
You can delete your account from Settings, then Privacy, then Delete Account. Pending orders and refunds must be completed first.

After deletion, your order history and wallet balance cannot be recovered. We keep invoices for 8 years as required by tax law.

title: Gift cards
text:
ShopKart gift cards are valid for 1 year from the date of purchase and can be used for any product except other gift cards.

Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash. If an order paid with a gift card is returned, the amount goes back to the gift card balance.

title: Coupons and offers
text:
Only one coupon can be applied per order. Coupons are not valid on gift cards or on items already marked as deal of the day.

If you return part of an order that used a coupon, the refund is reduced in proportion to the coupon discount.

title: Contacting customer support
text:
Chat with support 24 hours a day from Help in the app. Phone support is available from 8 am to 10 pm on 1800 123 4567, free of charge.

For complaints that are not resolved in 7 days, you can write to our grievance officer at grievance@shopkart.example.
